title: Waterfront C3: The east customs post, redrafted
request:
Redraft the tale for Waterfront C3 (The east customs post). Two earlier versions are source material: use any of their facts and jokes, copy neither whole.
- Prototype 7.13 (Farsight's voice; Farsight must not appear): The pier tower is a customs post. It logs everything that floats on the river: containers, ducks and, so far, one dummy, inbound. Be thrown into a car. Customs is watching.
- Prototype 8.1 (Dummy Corporation): The east pier tower is a customs post; it logs every Certified dummy that crosses the river to our clients. Be thrown into a car while a hit still throws you, and earn your entry.
Choose the length the tile needs, 15 to 35 words in at most two sentences: short when one image carries it, longer when the place has a history worth telling. Name the place, keep the duty and any equipment the tile issues, and point the place at the training.
